description: Compute tax under BOTH regimes for the same income and return a side-by-side comparison with the recommended regime and the savings amount. Pass the old-regime deductions you could actually claim; the new regime ignores them. `breakeven` says, from code, the smallest old-regime deductions at which the old regime costs no more than the new one and how much more that is than what was passed (null when no amount gets there). Quote it rather than estimating.

ageBand.description: Age band: below60, senior (60-79), superSenior (80+). Affects old-regime exemption only.

deductions.description: Old regime only: total Chapter VI-A deductions (80C, 80D, ...) in INR, EXCLUDING employer NPS (use employerNps80CCD2). Ignored under the new regime.

employerNps80CCD2.description: Employer's NPS contribution under s.80CCD(2) in INR. Allowed in BOTH regimes (the one Chapter VI-A deduction 115BAC keeps); capped at 14% of salary in the new regime, 10% (private) / 14% (government) in the old (FY 2025-26).

fy.description: Fiscal year, e.g. '2025-26' (AY 2026-27); '2026-27' is tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act 2025

governmentEmployer.description: Central/State Government employer (raises the old-regime 80CCD(2) cap to 14% for FY 2025-26)

housePropertyLoss.description: Loss under the head house property as a POSITIVE number: home-loan interest on the house you live in, or a let-out property's net loss. Requires housePropertyType. Old regime: set off against other heads up to Rs 2,00,000 (s.71(3A)). New regime: no inter-head set-off (s.115BAC(2)). Figures for FY 2025-26.

housePropertyType.description: Required when housePropertyLoss is above 0. 'selfOccupied': the home you live in; its interest is deductible only up to Rs 2,00,000 in the old regime (s.24(b)) and not at all in the new regime (s.115BAC(2)(i)), and what is above that is neither set off nor carried forward. 'letOut': no s.24(b) cap; the part not set off is carried forward (s.71B).

houses.description: Optional: every house owned, one entry each, INSTEAD of housePropertyLoss. The tool works out income from house property per regime (nil self-occupied interest under the new regime) and folds it in, so never add it to otherIncome yourself.

constructionCompletedFy.description: Financial year the purchase or construction was completed, e.g. '2023-24'

grossAnnualValue.description: Let out: rent received or receivable for the year (the owner's share if co-owned). Self-occupied: leave out, unless this house is past the self-occupied limit, when it is the rent it could fetch.

interestPayable.description: Home-loan interest for the year (interest only; principal is 80C, not this)

label.description: Name echoed back in the result, e.g. 'Pune flat'

loanQualifiesForHigherCap.description: Self-occupied only. Default true: the loan was taken on or after 1 April 1999 to buy or build the house and it was finished within five years, so interest is capped at Rs 2,00,000. False for an older loan, a repair loan or a late completion (cap Rs 30,000).

municipalTaxesPaid.description: Municipal tax the OWNER paid in the year (tenant-paid tax does not count)

preConstructionInterest.description: TOTAL interest for the years before the house was completed; the tool works out this year's 1/5 instalment from constructionCompletedFy

use.description: 'selfOccupied': the owner lives in it (or cannot, because work keeps them elsewhere); up to 2 such houses are valued at nil (s.23(2)), any more are deemed let out. 'letOut': let for the whole or any part of the year.

ltcg112A.description: Long-term capital gains under section 112A in INR, BEFORE the Rs 1,25,000 exemption

otherIncome.description: Other normal-rate income in INR (interest, net rent, etc.)

presumptiveBusiness.description: Optional: presumptive business or profession (44AD / 44ADA / 44AE). The tool works out the deemed income and adds it to otherIncome itself.

carriages.description: 44AE: each goods carriage owned in the year (the scheme allows at most 10 at any time)

grossWeightTons.description: Gross vehicle weight in tons; required for heavy

monthsOwned.description: Months owned in the year; a part month counts as full

type.description: heavy: gross vehicle weight above 12 tons (Rs 1,000 per ton a month); other: Rs 7,500 a month

cashReceiptsWithin5Pct.description: Cash receipts are at most 5% of the total, which lifts the ceiling to Rs 3,00,00,000 (44AD) or Rs 75,00,000 (44ADA). Required for 44ADA; for 44AD it is worked out from the two turnover figures when left out.

declaredProfit.description: A higher profit the taxpayer declares; the scheme taxes the deemed figure or more

digitalTurnover.description: 44AD: turnover received by account-payee cheque, bank transfer, UPI or other digital modes (deemed profit 6%)

maxCarriagesAtAnyTime.description: 44AE: the most carriages owned at any one time; defaults to the number listed

otherTurnover.description: 44AD: the rest of turnover, cash included (deemed profit 8%)

scheme.description: 44AD: small business on turnover. 44ADA: specified profession on gross receipts. 44AE: goods carriages.

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary income in INR, before standard deduction

stcg111A.description: Short-term capital gains under section 111A (listed equity, STT paid) in INR
